ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Please see http://publish.illinois.edu/onlinestudentorientation/online-business-minor-courses/ for more information. This course will open to all students in the College of Business on Monday, April 18, 2016 and to the campus on Monday, April 25, 2016 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
